from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687704/attempts/d0cbcca9117b44429be50328a5ec3220/system/state/workspace/programs/task-3cb0b820.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
src='''def transform(grid):
    """Connect aligned 1 markers; opposite-color crossings extend to borders."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    other_colors = {grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (1, max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid)))}
    # The background is the most frequent value; 1 is the line color.
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    pairs = []
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2, c2 in ones[i+1:]:
            dr, dc = r2-r1, c2-c1
            if dr != 0 and abs(dr) == abs(dc):
                pairs.append((r1, c1, r2, c2, 1 if dr*dc > 0 else -1))
    # Draw each diagonal segment joining aligned 1 markers.
    crossing_points = []
    for r1, c1, r2, c2, slope in pairs:
        dr = 1 if r2 > r1 else -1
        dc = 1 if c2 > c1 else -1
        length = abs(r2-r1)
        for k in range(length+1):
            r, c = r1+dr*k, c1+dc*k
            out[r][c] = 1
            if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 1):
                crossing_points.append((r, c, grid[r][c], slope))
    # A different-color marker on a 1-segment extends along the perpendicular
    # diagonal all the way to both grid edges. Its color wins at the crossing.
    for r, c, color, slope in crossing_points:
        # slope +1 for the 1-line means slope -1 for the cross-line, and vice versa.
        cross_dc = -1 if slope == 1 else 1
        rr, cc = r, c
        while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
            out[rr][cc] = color
            rr -= 1
            cc -= cross_dc
        rr, cc = r + 1, c + cross_dc
        while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
            out[rr][cc] = color
            rr += 1
            cc += cross_dc
    return out
'''
p.write_text(src)
